args.title: Brightline Freight – Freight Pricing This Quarter (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
- Brightline Freight's latest newsletter, "Freight pricing this quarter," links to a blog article and a free companion piece (registered with mei.novak@northwind.example).
- Article: Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion: Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
